class.name: WorldPartitionBake
class.brief_description: Bakes actor lists into a hierarchical World Partition style grid with data layers, HLOD clusters, one-file-per-actor storage, diffs and predictive cell selection.
class.description: Takes an [Array] of actor [Dictionary] entries with the keys [code]guid[/code] ([String], generated deterministically when empty), [code]position[/code] ([Vector3]), [code]bounds[/code] ([AABB]), [code]layers[/code] ([PackedStringArray]), [code]spatially_loaded[/code] ([bool]) and [code]data[/code] ([Dictionary]). [method bake] assigns every spatially loaded actor to a grid cell whose level grows with the actor extent (cell size doubles per level, up to [constant MAX_LEVEL]); cells are keyed [code]"<layer group>|<level>|<x>|<z>"[/code]. Actors that are not spatially loaded are always loaded. The concepts follow the publicly documented Unreal Engine World Partition ideas (runtime grid, data layers, One File Per Actor, HLOD); the implementation is original.

method.name: stable_guid
method.description: Returns a deterministic UUID-shaped GUID derived from [param seed]. The same seed always yields the same GUID.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes [param actors] into cells of level-0 size [param cell_size]. [param loading_range_by_layer] maps layer names (and the optional key [code]"default"[/code]) to a loading range. Returns and remembers a bake with the keys [code]cell_size[/code], [code]cells[/code], [code]always_loaded[/code], [code]layers[/code] and [code]actors[/code].

method.name: get_baked
method.description: Returns the most recent result of [method bake].

method.name: hlod_clusters
method.description: Groups baked [param cells] into HLOD clusters of [param cluster_cells] x [param cluster_cells] cells (within each cell's own level), keeping data layer groups separate. Each cluster contains [code]key[/code], [code]level[/code], [code]group[/code], [code]bounds[/code], [code]cells[/code] and [code]actors[/code].

method.name: split_one_file_per_actor
method.description: Writes one [code]<guid>.json[/code] file per actor into [param dir_path] (via a temporary file and rename). Actors without a GUID are skipped. Returns the number of files written.

method.name: load_actors
method.description: Reads back every [code].json[/code] actor file from [param dir_path], sorted by file name. Returns an empty array when the directory cannot be opened.

method.name: diff_bakes
method.description: Compares two bakes. Returns [code]added[/code], [code]removed[/code], [code]moved[/code] (position, bounds or cell changed), [code]changed[/code] (data hash changed) and the sorted [code]dirty_cells[/code] that need rebuilding.

method.name: cells_to_load
method.description: Returns the cell keys of the last bake that should be streamed in for a source at [param source_pos], also sampling points along [param velocity] (predictive look-ahead). Cells whose data layers are all disabled are skipped. The result is sorted nearest first.

members.member: Seconds of travel simulated ahead of the streaming source by [method cells_to_load].
Number of sample points along the look-ahead segment used by [method cells_to_load].
